title: Phrases in Gaelic this Holiday Season

children.html:
Would you like to impress your loved ones this Holiday Season and learn a few phrases in Gaelic?  Now is your chance!

Christmas happiness be with you!  Nollaig shona duit!  <<Noll-ag hunna ditch>> 

A happy and prosperous Christmas to you!  Nollaig faoi shéan is faoi shaonas duit!  <<Noll-ag fwee shee-an iss fwee show-nas-ditch>>

The blessings of Christmas be with you!  Beannachtaí na Nollag duit!  <<Ban-ach-tee na noll-ag ditch>>

Happy New Year!  Athbhliain faoi mhaise duit!  <<Ah-vleen fwee vosh-ah ditch>>

Season's Greetings!  Beannachtaí an tSéasúir!  <<Ban-ach-tee on tay-sur>>

Written by Taryn Harrison
